title: calamintha hydaspidis
intro: Calamintha hydaspidis, commonly known as Mountain Melissa, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). The plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to alleviate anxiety and stress, as well as its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. Therapeutically, Calamintha hydaspidis is used to stimulate digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and promote relaxation. Its bioactive constituents include essential oils, such as camphor and borneol, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and medicinal uses.
